title: 第24章信第25章方铭突破
content_zh:
“对。”方圆拿起一盏油灯，点燃，探进洞口。
火光照亮了洞壁。洞壁是夯土砌的，上面有明显的凿痕，不是天然形成的，而是人为挖掘的。台阶也是人工凿出来的，虽然粗糙，但每一步都很稳。
“我下去。”方圆说，“你在上面等着。”
“不行。”王紫璇摇头，“上次在山洞里你就让我等着，结果差点被殷无极拍死。这次我要跟你一起下去。”
方圆看着她，没有争辩。
“跟紧我。”
两人一前一后钻进了密道。
方七带着暗卫守在祠堂门口，将大门重新关上。
密道里很黑，油灯的光只能照亮前方几尺的距离。方圆走在前面，左手举着油灯，右手凝聚着一团金色的灵气，随时准备出手。
密道向下延伸了大约三十丈，然后变得平坦，向前延伸。从方向上判断，密道正在向方家大院以外延伸，方向是——西北。
青州城的西北方向，是烈阳宗的地盘。
殷无极在方家地下挖了一条密道，直通烈阳宗。
这个发现让方圆的心沉了下去。
不是因为他没想到，而是因为这个密道的规模太大了。从祠堂到烈阳宗，直线距离至少有五里地。在地下五里长的密道，不是一个人能干完的活儿，需要大量的人力和物力。
殷无极在方家地下挖了三年，方家上下竟然没有一个人发现。
这说明参与挖掘的人，要么死了，要么被灭口了。
方圆加快了脚步。
密道走了大约半个时辰，前方出现了一道石门。
石门是青石雕刻的，两扇对开，每扇门上刻着一个恶鬼的头像，嘴巴大张，獠牙外露，栩栩如生。
方圆伸手推了推石门，纹丝不动。

门上没有锁，没有把手，只有一个巴掌大的凹陷，形状不规则，像是什么东西的模子。
王紫璇凑近看了看：“这是钥匙孔？”
方圆盯着那个凹陷看了几秒，从怀中取出一块东西——方正林死前身上掉下来的半块玉佩。
他试着将玉佩放入凹陷中。
不大不小，严丝合缝。
方圆微微一怔，随即明白了。这块玉佩是方正林从殷无极那里得到的“通行证”，专门用来开这扇门的。方正林死了，玉佩落到了他手里。
方圆按了一下玉佩，石门内部传来咔咔的声响，两扇门缓缓向两侧滑开。
石门后面是一个巨大的地下空间。
方圆举起油灯，火光映照出空间的全貌——那是一个方圆数十丈的大厅，高约两丈，顶部是拱形的石穹顶，地面上铺着整齐的青石板。
大厅的正中央，有一个圆形的祭坛。
方圆的心脏猛地一跳。
这个祭坛，和苍茫山地下那个祭坛一模一样。
一样的黑色石头，一样的红色纹路，一样四角的石柱。区别只在于苍茫山那个祭坛上供奉的是万劫魔石，而这个祭坛的正中央是一口井。
井口不大，直径约一丈，井沿上刻满了密密麻麻的符文。井里黑漆漆的，看不到底，但从井口中涌出的灵气浓郁得惊人，几乎凝成了实质。
方圆走到井边，往下看了一眼。
井壁上嵌满了灵石——不是普通的灵石，是极品灵石，每一块都散发着浓郁的灵气。从灵气的浓度判断，这口井的深度至少有百丈，井壁上嵌着的灵石少说有上万块。
上万块极品灵石。
content_en:
"Yes." Fang Yuan picked up an oil lamp, lit it, and probed into the cave entrance.
The fire illuminated the cave walls. The cave wall is made of rammed earth, and there are obvious chisel marks on it. They are not formed naturally, but were excavated by humans. The steps are also hand-hewn. Although rough, every step is stable.
"I'll go down." Fangyuan said, "You wait above."
"No." Wang Zixuan shook his head, "Last time you asked me to wait in the cave, and I was almost beaten to death by Yin Wuji. This time I want to go down with you."
Fangyuan looked at her without arguing.
"Follow me."
The two of them got into the secret passage one after the other.
Fang Qi led the secret guards to guard the door of the ancestral hall and closed the door again.
It was very dark in the secret passage, and the light from the oil lamp could only illuminate a few feet ahead. Fangyuan walked in front, holding an oil lamp in his left hand, and a ball of golden spiritual energy condensed in his right hand, ready to take action at any time.
The secret passage extended downward for about thirty feet, then became flat and extended forward. Judging from the direction, the secret passage is extending outside the Fang family compound, and the direction is northwest.
To the northwest of Qingzhou City is the territory of Lieyang Sect.
Yin Wuji dug a secret tunnel under the Fang family, leading directly to Lieyang Sect.
This discovery made Fangyuan's heart sink.
It's not because he didn't expect it, but because the scale of this secret passage is too big. From the ancestral hall to Lieyang Sect, the straight-line distance is at least five miles. The five-mile-long secret tunnel underground is not a job that can be completed by one person. It requires a lot of manpower and material resources.
Yin Wuji dug under the Fang family for three years, but no one in the Fang family discovered it.
This shows that the people involved in the excavation are either dead or silenced.
Fangyuan quickened his pace.
After walking through the secret passage for about half an hour, a stone door appeared in front of them.
The stone door is carved from bluestone, with two doors facing each other. Each door is carved with the head of an evil spirit, with its mouth wide open and fangs exposed, which is lifelike.
Fang Yuan reached out and pushed the stone door, but it didn't move.
There was no lock or handle on the door, just a palm-sized depression with an irregular shape, like a mold of something.
Wang Zixuan took a closer look: "Is this a keyhole?"
Fangyuan stared at the depression for a few seconds, then took out a piece of something from his arms - half of a jade pendant that fell from Fang Zhenglin's body before he died.
He tried to put the jade pendant into the depression.
Not too big, not too small, just perfect.
Fangyuan was startled for a moment, then understood. This jade pendant was the "pass" Fang Zhenglin got from Yin Wuji, and was specially used to open this door. Fang Zhenglin died, and the jade pendant fell into his hands.
Fangyuan pressed the jade pendant, and a clicking sound came from inside the stone door, and the two doors slowly slid open to both sides.
Behind the stone door is a huge underground space.
Fangyuan raised the oil lamp, and the firelight reflected the entire space - it was a hall dozens of feet in diameter, about two feet high, with an arched stone dome on top, and neat bluestone slabs on the ground.
In the center of the hall, there is a circular altar.
Fangyuan's heart skipped a beat.
This altar is exactly the same as the one under Cangmang Mountain.
The same black stone, the same red lines, the same stone pillars at the four corners. The only difference is that the altar in Cangmang Mountain enshrines the Demonic Stone of Ten Thousand Tribulations, and the center of this altar is a well.
The mouth of the well is not big, about one foot in diameter, and the edge of the well is covered with dense runes. The well was pitch black and could not be seen to the bottom, but the spiritual energy pouring out of the well mouth was so strong that it almost condensed into substance.
Fangyuan walked to the edge of the well and looked down.
The walls of the well are embedded with spiritual stones - not ordinary spiritual stones, but top-grade spiritual stones, each piece exuding rich spiritual energy. Judging from the concentration of spiritual energy, the depth of this well is at least a hundred feet, and there are at least tens of thousands of spiritual stones embedded in the walls of the well.
Tens of thousands of top-quality spiritual stones.
